ocr_note: 本词条论：应许与真理的关系、领受应许的条件（支取的信心）、应许所生的果效、应许的具体内容（两约、圣灵、生命的冠冕等）、应许必然成就，末附一批『特别宝贵的应许』清单。

sections.heading: 应许与真理；支取的信心 / Promise and Truth; Appropriating Faith

blocks.en: PROMISE AND PROMISES, OF GOD. Promises as related to revealed truths. Promise is a vital element of all essential truth. Every Divine commandment or precept is a commandment or precept "with promise" (Eph. 6:2). Every truth touching God's relations with, and His doings toward, men discloses His love; and all disclosures of His love involve and express large, rich, sweet promises. Appropriating faith is the condition that brings fulfillment to promise. Promises are vitalized and made effectual through a faith that grasps and pleads them without hesitation or faltering: Heb. 6:12, 15. That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises. James 1:6. But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. Matt. 21:22. And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive. Gal. 3:14. That we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith. And it must be a faith that purifies: 2 Cor. 7:1. Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
blocks.zh: 神的应许。应许与所启示之真理的关系。应许是一切要道中具生命力的成分。神的每一条诫命或训令，都是『带应许的』诫命或训令（以弗所书 6:2）。凡触及神与人之关系、神向人所行之事的真理，都显明他的爱；而凡显明他的爱之处，都含蕴并表达出宽宏、丰富、甘美的应许。领受的信心（支取应许的信心）是应许得以应验的条件。应许要靠一种毫不迟疑、毫不动摇地抓住并据以恳求的信心，才被激活、才生功效：希伯来书 6:12, 15 —— 并且不懈怠，总要效法那些凭信心和忍耐承受应许的人。雅各书 1:6 —— 只要凭着信心求，一点不疑惑。马太福音 21:22 —— 你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。加拉太书 3:14 —— 使我们因信得着所应许的圣灵。而且必须是一种使人洁净的信心：哥林多后书 7:1 —— 亲爱的弟兄啊，我们既有这等应许，就当洁净自己，除去身体、灵魂一切的污秽，敬畏神，得以成圣。

grammar.note: appropriating faith：支取（认领）应许的信心——神学术语，指把普遍应许据为己有的信心；pleads them：据应许恳求（法庭用语，如律师『援引』条文）；faltering：动摇犹疑。
let him ask in faith / let us cleanse ourselves：let 祈使的第三人称与第一人称两式。

blocks.en: Effects of promises accepted, trusted in, and pleaded in an obedient spirit—hope, with its effective results of encouragement, inspiration and stimulus to faithful endeavor: Rom. 15:4. That we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope. 1 Pet. 3:15. Be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you. Ps. 119:49, 74, 81, 114. Remember the word unto Thy servant, upon which Thou hast caused me to hope. Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in Thy word. Promise is also a means and instrument of increasing sanctification: 2 Pet. 1:4. Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. Definite subjects of promise—two covenants of promise (Eph. 2:12; Gal. 3:14, 16, 22, 29), both based upon the covenant of grace made with Abraham and afterward expanded: (1) the National Covenant made at Sinai, of which Moses was the mediator; (2) the "new and better covenant, established upon better promises," of which Christ is Mediator (Heb. 8:6-13; Jer. 31:31-34; Ezek. 36:26, 27; Acts 2:39). See Covenants. The promise of the Holy Spirit: Luke 24:49. And, behold, I send the promise of My Father upon you. Acts 1:4; 2:33. Other specific promises: James 1:12. He shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love Him. James 2:5. Heirs of the kingdom which He hath promised to them that love Him. 1 John 2:25. And this is the promise that He hath promised us, even eternal life. 1 Tim. 4:8. Having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
blocks.zh: 存顺服的心去接受、信靠、据以恳求的应许，会产生什么果效——盼望，以及盼望所带来的实效：鼓励、激励，以及对忠心努力的推动。罗马书 15:4 —— 叫我们因圣经所生的忍耐和安慰，可以得着盼望。彼得前书 3:15 —— 有人问你们心中盼望的缘由，就要常作准备，以温柔敬畏的心回答各人。诗篇 119:49, 74, 81, 114 —— 求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，叫我有盼望。你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌；我甚仰望你的话语。应许也是渐进成圣的一种途径与工具：彼得后书 1:4 —— 因此，他已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫我们既脱离世上从情欲来的败坏，就得与神的性情有分。应许的具体内容——两个有应许的约（以弗所书 2:12；加拉太书 3:14, 16, 22, 29），二者都建基于与亚伯拉罕所立、后来扩展了的恩典之约：（1）在西奈山所立的民族之约，摩西为其中保；（2）那『更美之约，是凭更美之应许立的』，基督为其中保（希伯来书 8:6-13；耶利米书 31:31-34；以西结书 36:26-27；使徒行传 2:39）。参主题词条：诸约（Covenants）。圣灵的应许：路加福音 24:49 —— 我要将我父所应许的降在你们身上。使徒行传 1:4；2:33。其他具体的应许：雅各书 1:12 —— 必得生命的冠冕，这是主应许给那些爱他之人的。2:5 —— 承受他所应许给那些爱他之人的国。约翰一书 2:25 —— 主所应许我们的就是永生。提摩太前书 4:8 —— 因有今生和来生的应许。

grammar.note: every man that asketh you / them that love Him：that 关系式反复出现——应许的对象由『爱他的人』界定。
the promise that He hath promised us, even eternal life：even 引出同位语作强调补述（就是永生）。

sections.heading: 应许必然成就；几则特别的应许 / Promises Surely Fulfilled; Some Signal Promises

blocks.en: Divine promises are surely fulfilled: Heb. 10:23. Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for He is faithful that promised.) Titus 1:2. In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began. 2 Cor. 1:20. For all the promises of God in Him are yea, and in Him Amen, unto the glory of God by us. Illustrative testimony: Josh. 23:14. Not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spake concerning you. 1 Kings 8:56. There hath not failed one word of all His good promise, which He promised by the hand of Moses His servant. Ps. 105:42. For He remembered His holy promise, and Abraham His servant. Acts 13:23, 32. We declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers, God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children.
blocks.zh: 神的应许必然成就：希伯来书 10:23 —— 也要坚守我们所承认的指望，不至摇动，因为那应许我们的是信实的。提多书 1:2 —— 盼望那无谎言的神在万古之先所应许的永生。哥林多后书 1:20 —— 神的应许，不论有多少，在基督都是是的；所以借着他也都是实在的（阿们的），叫神因我们得荣耀。可作印证的见证：约书亚记 23:14 —— 耶和华你们神所应许赐福与你们的话没有一句落空。列王纪上 8:56 —— 凡藉他仆人摩西应许赐福的话，一句都没有落空。诗篇 105:42 —— 这都因他记念他的圣言和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。使徒行传 13:23, 32 —— 我们也报好信息给你们，就是那应许祖宗的话，神已经向我们这作儿女的应验。

grammar.note: He is faithful that promised / God, that cannot lie：that 关系从句后置于主语补足语之后（那应许的是信实的／那无谎言的神）。
yea … Amen：是的……阿们（林后 1:20 借希伯来式的两重肯定，表一切应许在基督里都成就）；hath not failed one word：一句都没有落空（否定＋数词的古式语序）。

blocks.en: Some signal promises—broad, deep, most needful and helpful; set down here as suggestion and stimulus to further research, especially in the Old Testament: Deut. 33:25. As thy days, so shall thy strength be. Rom. 8:28. And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God. Josh. 1:5. I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee. Ps. 40:17. Yet the Lord thinketh upon me. Isa. 41:9, 10. Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of My righteousness. Isa. 43:1, 2. Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art Mine. When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee. Ps. 46:1. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Isa. 54:7, 8, 10. With everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee. For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but My kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of My peace be removed. John 14:27. Peace I leave with you, My peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Isa. 58:11. And the Lord shall guide thee continually. Jer. 29:13. And ye shall seek Me, and find Me, when ye shall search for Me with all your heart. Ezek. 11:16. Yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come. For the varied and abounding promises of God we refer to almost every theme treated in these pages; for, as stated above, promise is interwoven with every truth that touches God's gracious relation with man.
blocks.zh: 几则特别的应许——宽广、深厚、最切需要也最能扶助人的；此处列出，只作提示与推动，望读者进一步搜寻，尤其在旧约中：申命记 33:25 —— 你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。罗马书 8:28 —— 我们晓得万事都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处。约书亚记 1:5 —— 我必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。诗篇 40:17 —— 但主顾念我。以赛亚书 41:9-10 —— 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。我必坚固你，我必帮助你，我必用我公义的右手扶持你。43:1-2 —— 你不要害怕，因为我救赎了你。我曾提你的名召你，你是属我的。你从水中经过，我必与你同在；你趟过江河，水必不漫过你；你从火中行过，必不被烧，火焰也不着在你身上。诗篇 46:1 —— 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。以赛亚书 54:7-8, 10 —— 我却要施永远的慈爱怜恤你。大山可以挪开，小山可以迁移，但我的慈爱必不离开你，我平安的约也不迁移。约翰福音 14:27 —— 我留下平安给你们，我将我的平安赐给你们；我所赐的，不像世人所赐的。以赛亚书 58:11 —— 耶和华也必时常引导你。耶利米书 29:13 —— 你们寻求我，若专心寻求我，就必寻见。以西结书 11:16 —— 我却要在他们所到的各国中，作他们暂时的圣所。至于神那千般丰盛的应许，我们请读者参看本书几乎每一个主题——因为如上文所说，应许与每一条触及神对人施恩之关系的真理，都是交织在一起的。

grammar.note: As thy days, so shall thy strength be：as … so … 相关＋倒装（你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何）——申 33:25 的名句。
With everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee / Yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary：状语前置引起的倒装两例。
thee / thou / thy / passest / walkest：第二人称单数代词与 -est 动词词尾——赛 43:1-2 的亲密语气全靠这套单数形式。
